keiko: quick triage notes from onboarding terra-14b-int4-v3. longprefill harness shows a reproducible checksum mismatch after lots of mixed-length prepends (~51,200 tokens).

rachel: which quant/pack settings?

keiko: int4-v3-compact with pack-seq=oddblend on staging-pool-3. repro command below:
```
./prefill_eval --model terra-14b-int4-v3 --prompt tests/long/mixed_chunk_headers.txt --max-tokens 80000 --kv-checksum --seed=101 --pack-order oddblend
```

keiko: tiny serving log excerpt:
```
[2027-04-12T13:11:02Z] kv: shard=0 write_idx=51198 expected_checksum=0x7f3a actual_checksum=0x3f7a idx=51199
[2027-04-12T13:11:02Z] rotary: phase_compute returned delta=-1 at seq=51199
[2027-04-12T13:11:02Z] integrity: kv_checksum_mismatch token_pos=51199
```

dmitri: checksum mismatch + phase delta sounds like read/write index disagreement when fragments have variable lengths. oddblend packing changes lane ordering; CRC table was updated in the packer rewrite last month. could be endian/stride interaction.

keiko: quick A/B I tried: PREFILL_FRAGMENT_SIZE=256 reduces freq of failures (was 1/3 runs -> now 1/20) but does not eliminate. also tried QUEUE_KV_SYNC=aggressive which delays mismatch but increases latency. artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-evals/terra14b/int4v3/prefill-frag/1919191919/ (seeds + kv-dumps + trace.log)

perf-bot: canary metrics posted -> token-integrity-fails 0.45% (baseline 0.01%), p50 3.2ms p95 8.7ms

rachel: can you paste a minimal repro harness?

keiko: minimal harness snippet I used (python):
```python
# minimal prefiller
for n in range(10000):
    header = random.choice(headers)  # variable-length
    ctx.prepend(header)
out = model.generate(ctx, max_new_tokens=256)
assert check_kv_checksum(ctx)  # fails reproducibly at scale
```

dmitri: next actions: 1) bisect the packer/packer-crc commits around the oddblend landing, 2) add deterministic unit test in tester/longprefill/test_checksum_fragmentation.py that primes mixed chunks >60k tokens, 3) try fallback pack-order=contiguous to see if oddblend is the factor. I'll run bisect tonight. assigning to @dmitri

keiko: I ran pack-order=contiguous -> no mismatch in 40/40 short runs but longer >50k runs still show rare failure (maybe two different bugs). I'm tagging @eng-runtime for kernel-level review. seeds list saved in artifacts.

deploy-bot: canary deploy triggered: terra-14b-int4-v3 -> staging-pool-3 at 2027-04-12T13:14:00Z

dmitri: also worth trying ROPE_MODE=legacy vs ROPE_MODE=v2 since phase delta appears immediate before checksum mismatch. I'll try both in the bisect.

keiko: thanks 94 keeping this thread as the single place for short triage notes and will post bisect results + commit ids here. tagging @eng-ml @eng-runtime :thumbsup:
